activities.description: Locates an address based on a given point.

url.description: The URL of the geocoding service. For example, http://<catalog-url>/<serviceName>/GeocodeServer.

location.description: The point at which to search for the closest address. The location parameter can be represented by a Point object or as a comma-separated list. If comma-separated values are used, they must be in the following format: <XCoordinate>,<YCoordinate>.

A geocode service that supports intersections will include the IntersectionConnectors property in the service description. This parameter was added at 10.3.

commandTimeout.description: The timeout value in seconds to wait for results from the SQL command. If not specified, the default value for the provider will be used.
commandTimeout.name: commandTimeout

dataTable.description: A DataTable representing the results returned from the query. The DataTable 'Rows' property can be indexed by both row number and column name. For example, $datatable.Rows[2]['GRADE'] will access the GRADE column of the third row in the results.
dataTable.name: dataTable

activities.description: Writes text content to a file on the server.

path.description: The path to write the content to on the server.
path.name: path

encoding.description: The character encoding of the text content. The encoding must be supported by the server or the workflow will fail with an error. If you do not specify an encoding, the server's default encoding will be used.
encoding.name: encoding

activities.description: Writes byte content to a file on the server.

path.description: The path to write the content to on the server.
path.name: path

activities.description: Presents an alert dialog to the user.

text.description: The message to display in the alert dialog.
text.name: text

title.description: The title to display in the alert dialog.
title.name: title

markdown.description: Use this to control when the Text input should be considered Markdown. The default is false.
markdown.name: markdown

activities.description: Presents a confirmation dialog to the user.

text.description: The message to display in the confirm dialog.
text.name: text

title.description: The title to display in the confirm dialog.
title.name: title

markdown.description: Use this to control when the Text input should be considered Markdown. The default is false.
markdown.name: markdown

result.description: The result of the confirm dialog.
result.name: result

activities.description: Presents a text prompt dialog to the user.

description.description: The message to display in the prompt dialog.
description.name: description

defaultText.description: The default text of the prompt input.
defaultText.name: defaultText

title.description: The title to display in the prompt dialog.
title.name: title

markdown.description: Use this to control when the Description input should be considered Markdown. The default is false.
markdown.name: markdown

result.description: The result of the prompt dialog.
result.name: result

activities.description: Opens a Web AppBuilder widget.

widgetId.description: The Id of the widget to open.
widgetId.name: widgetId

activities.description: Sends data between widgets.

keepHistory.description: If true, all published data is stored in the DataManager. If false, only the latest data is stored in DataManager. The default value is false.
keepHistory.name: keepHistory

activities.description: Converts one or more DataTables to a Microsoft Excel (.xlsx) workbook.

dataTable.description: The table or tables to convert.
dataTable.name: dataTable

password.description: The password for the Microsoft Excel (.xlsx) workbook.
password.name: password

result.description: The result byte content of the Microsoft Excel (.xlsx) workbook file.
result.name: result

activities.description: Converts a Microsoft Excel (.xlsx) workbook to a DataSet.

xlsx.description: The byte content of the Microsoft Excel (.xlsx) workbook file.
xlsx.name: xlsx

password.description: The password to the Microsoft Excel (.xlsx) workbook. This is only required if the workbook is protected.
password.name: password

useFirstRowAsHeader.description: Assume the first row is the header, for column names. When false, columns are named "Column" with a numeric suffix. Default is true.
useFirstRowAsHeader.name: useFirstRowAsHeader

inferColumnTypes.description: Attempt to guess the data type of the columns based on the values. When false, all columns are of type "object". Default is false.
inferColumnTypes.name: inferColumnTypes

result.description: A DataSet representing the worksheets in the Microsoft Excel workbook. Each worksheet in the workbook will be a table in the DataSet.
result.name: result
